Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
What damage is considered to be "inflicted" by a minion? Only damage from
strikes and damage that uses the word inflict?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
GreySeer wrote:
>
> What damage is considered to be "inflicted" by a minion? Only damage from
> strikes and damage that uses the word inflict?

Yes. Online rulings:

Damage (Combat)

Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the damage is from
a strike or if an effect specifically states that the damage is dealt by the
minion. Damage from other effects is considered "environmental," and has no
particular source. [RTR 19970630]

I was wondering because of the wording of Pulled Fangs.

"Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this minion inflicted
more damage at close range than the opposing vampire. Not usable by a dying
ally or a vampire going into torpor. Put this card on the opposing vampire
and inflict 1 point of damage. The victim cannot hunt until this card is
removed. Any vampire(s) may burn this card with two +1 stealth (D) actions.
If the victim must hunt and cannot, he or she goes into torpor. A vampire
can have only one Pulled Fangs."

And Riposte

"[cel] Strike: combat ends [and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once
combat ends] if the range is close (damage not preventable). Not usable on
the first round of combat. [CEL] As above, but inflict 2 damage."

It doesn't explicitly say that the damage is inflicted by the minion playing
the card but the fact that it has the word inflict to me indicates that it
is being inflicted by the minion which played the card. As opposed to "takes
x damage effects" where the damage, even if the damage dealt is the result
of a successful strike is not considered to be done by the minion playing
the card, simply because it does not use the word inflict or say "this
vampire deals x damage...".
